quest.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 5
quest.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight! I didn't expect to run into you here!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Yes! I finally got the chance to come here on vacation, and I wanted to bring a few gifts back for the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I heard that, during Lantern Rite, locals like to include one of these envelopes with their gifts.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: So, I wanted to follow their lead and make a few gift envelopes of my own. But, they're not looking too good...

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I want my gift envelopes to be beautiful! Can you show me how, Honorary Knight?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course, leave it to me.

talks.objective: Complete the Gift Envelope with Noelle

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: So, that's how it works... Wow, is there anything you can't do?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Thank you for teaching me. I'll treasure this gift envelope!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Be sure to stop by the next Windblume Festival, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: When that day comes, I'll make you a gift envelope just as beautiful as this one.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I want my gift envelopes to be beautiful! Can you show me how, Honorary Knight?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course, leave it to me.
